# GameSquire

> GameSquire is a board game collection tracker and play log with a friends layer. It helps a group answer "what should we play tonight?" by filtering your shelf, a friend's shelf or your household's shared shelf by mood and occasion. Free to use with no ads. An optional paid Knight subscription adds more of the extras.

## What it does

- Track the board games you own and want, with a free shelf, wishlist and play log
- See what friends own and what you can both play, with collection matching
- Share one shelf with up to 5 people in a household
- Import your BoardGameGeek collection, wishlist, ratings and plays, and export to CSV any time
- Ask the Herald, the rules assistant, questions about a game's rulebook
- Learn to play guides for popular games

## Who it is for

Board game players who want to pick a game quickly with the people around them, track what they own and have played, and see their friends' shelves.

## Platforms

iPhone, iPad, Android and the web, all with one account. Free to download.
